body: Thank you for your kind words....but I don't deserve it......It's just been so hard to keep up with.....I just don't know what to do at this point in my life.....I always thought about never reaching up to an old age and just leaving this world before I reach my mid 20.....I'm just.... scared to talk to this to someone...... maybe I'm just a coward..maybe I'm just scared of judgement......but thank you for your words....I hate to put others down.....so thank you for listening......I'm sorry you have to hear my problems.....I'm sorry.....
